name: Optimization Objective Obfuscation
description: Replaced the explicit "lexicographically smallest" tie-break rule with a mathematical equivalent (minimizing a base-4 polynomial) to trap models into performing an exhaustive search of all valid assignments. Replaced the static parity matrix with a `gcd` condition on shifted values (5, 6, 7 are pairwise coprime) to prevent immediate pattern-matching to 3-coloring. Models that reason will recognize the polynomial as lexicographical order and terminate early; models that blindly translate will TLE or overflow on N=40.
